title: 感性形成演習
subtitle: Technical Seeing and Hearing
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Learn human visual and auditory processing within the context of physiology and psychology. (2) Train to be able to discriminate and identify the value, chroma, and hue of visual stimuli. (3) Train to be able to discriminate between slight differences in the frequency and intensity of auditory stimuli. Additionally, train to be able to identify the frequency and intensity of auditory stimuli quantitatively. (4) Discuss application of the skills obtained for regional cooperation.
advice: This is a basic skills course for “technical seeing and hearing”. We will cover the following materials: 1. Human perception processing for visual and auditory stimuli. 2. Training for discrimination or identification of the value, chroma, and hue of visual stimuli. 3. Training for discriminating between slight difference in frequency and intensity of auditory stimuli. 4. Training for identifying the frequency and intensity of auditory stimuli. The contents of this class are related to “Project for Technical Seeing and Hearing”.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand human perception processing for visual and auditory stimuli.
Be able to discriminate the value, chroma, and hue of visual stimuli.
Be able to identify the value, chroma, and hue of visual stimuli using Munsell notation.
Be able to discriminate between slight differences in frequency and intensity of auditory stimuli.
Be able to identify the frequency and intensity of auditory stimuli.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Be able to explain human visual and auditory perception mechanisms. (2) Be able to explain physical and psychological quantities of visual and auditory stimuli. (3) Be able to represent a color that you imagined using Munsell notation quantitatively. (4) Be able to represent a sound that you imagined by emphasizing the music frequency band.
achievementLevels.standard: (1)Be able to understand human visual and auditory perception mechanisms. (2)Be able to understand the physical and psychological quantities of visual and auditory stimuli. (3) Be able to discriminate the value, chroma, and hue of color. (4)Be able to identify the value, chroma, and hue of color. (5) Be able to discriminate between slight differences in frequency and intensity of sound. (6) Be able to identify the frequency and intensity of sound. (7) Be able to identify the center frequency of sound that has an emphasized specific frequency band.
